nodes.title: Z-Image Total Fun Workflow: README
widgets_values:
## Anime

This is an experimental workflow for generating images that resemble anime and manga-style artwork.

## Parameters

__seed__
* The initial number for random generation. Each unique seed produces a different image.
* Results in significantly more dramatic variations when __"turbo_creativity"__ is turned on.

__style__
* The visual style that defines the overall look of your final image.

__palette__
* The color palette to use. This acts as a guide and is not always strictly followed in the final generated image.

__imprint_style_label__
* Prints the name of the selected style directly onto the image.
* It is recommended to leave this disabled by default.

__prompt__
* The text description of what you want to see, including subjects, actions, and settings.
* Avoid style keywords such as photo, comic, or blur, as the selected styles handle all visual effects automatically.

__steps__
* The number of iterations performed during the denoising process.
* The optimal setting is 8 steps. Increase this value only if you require better quality or need to fix minor hallucinations caused by __"turbo_creativity"__, keeping in mind that higher step counts result in longer render times.

__initial_bias__
* Adjusts the starting noise deviation to correct color issues, brightness, or even weird hallucinations.
* 0.0 serves as the optimal setting and is generally best left unchanged due to its unpredictable effects.

__turbo_creativity__
* Shakes up the generation process to produce unique, original compositions and avoid generic AI aesthetics.
* It is prone to generating hallucinations and duplicate elements, especially in high-contrast images.
* Disable this feature if you require highly precise and complex images.
* Enable this feature when exploring creative compositions with substantial variations between different seeds.
* Working with __turbo_creativity__ involves testing multiple seeds until you find the ideal one.
* Some minor defects and small hallucinations can be corrected by tweaking __"steps"__ and __"initial_bias"__.
* Note that seed numbers that are multiples of 3 cause __turbo_creativity__ to hallucinate more frequently, as the sampler internally skips one correction step to maximize image variation.

__detailed_sampling__
* Applies a different sampling method during the final steps to add finer details, although it may increase the generation time.

__contrast__
* Controls how smooth or intense the brightness transitions appear in the final image.
* 0.0 serves as the neutral baseline.

__color__
* Adjusts the color saturation of the image.
* 0.0 serves as the neutral baseline.

__hue__
* Modifies the color tint, primarily used to calibrate skin tones.
* 0.0 serves as the neutral baseline.

__orientation__
* Sets the orientation of the final image, where vertical creates a portrait format and horizontal creates a landscape format.

__aspect_ratio__
* Determines the proportional relationship between the width and height of the final image.

__ck_attention__
* Enables Comfy-Kitchen attention to reduce generation time. This takes effect only in newer versions of ComfyUI that support this optimization.

__zimage_turbo_ckpt__
* The checkpoint file used for the Z-Image Turbo diffusion model.

__qwen3_4b_ckpt__
* The checkpoint file used as text encoder, which must be based on the Qwen3-4b model.

__vae__
* The checkpoint file used for the variational autoencoder.

## Created by Martin Rizzo
* GitHub : https://github.com/martin-rizzo
* CivitAI: https://civitai.com/user/Photographer
* Reddit : https://www.reddit.com/user/FotografoVirtual

>## HOW TO WRITE A STYLE TEMPLATE
>##    Focus exclusively on visual aesthetics, atmospheric mood, and technical
>##    characteristics (e.g., lighting, texture, lens, weather, and sensory details).
>##    Avoid referencing specific subjects, objects, or characters, as these are
>##    supplied by the user via the {$@} placeholder. Treat the template as a
>##    "lens" or "filter": it dictates how the scene looks and feels, not what
>##    is explicitly happening within it.
>##
>## TEMPLATE DEFINITION
>##    Each new visual style must begin with a line prefixed by ">>>"
>##    followed by the style name. Example: ">>> Landscape Photo"
>##
>## TEMPLATE FORMAT
>##    Every line following the style name represents the prompt used
>##    when that style is selected. The following variables are processed:
>##
>##    {$@} : Replaced by the user's input prompt.
>##
>##    {$IFPAL X | Y} :
>##         Conditional logic for color palettes.
>##         - If a color palette is active, the text before '|' (X) is used.
>##         - If no palette is selected, the text after '|' (Y) is used.
>##         - Within 'X', reference palette colors using $1, $2, $3, and $4.
>##         - Los $1, $2, $3, $4 estan ordenados de mas luminoso $1 a mas oscuro $4
>##         - $5 is an optional highlight color (available solo en algunas palettes).
>##
>##    {$**<cheat-code> X | Y} :
>##         Quick Modifier System
>##         - <cheat-code> consists of one or more characters from: @, *, #, +, -
>##         - If the user's prompt begins with "**<cheat-code>" (e.g., "**@@"), 
>##           the text 'X' is applied.
>##         - If no matching prefix is found, the text 'Y' is applied.
>##
>##    In this file, the following cheat-codes are used:
>##      "@@" : Spicy Impact Booster (enhances sensual and provocative tones)
>##      "##" : Original Framing & Perspective (dutch tilt, dynamic angles)
>##


>>> Ancient Ink Manga Illustration
YOUR CONTEXT
You are a master traditional manga artist and printmaker, working with the timeless language of sumi-e ink and washi paper. Your aesthetic captures the expressive dynamism of classic Japanese illustration, rooted in the fluid precision of brushwork and the tactile geometry of manual screening techniques. The artwork is defined by a rigorous hierarchy of line weights: bold, confident outlines anchor the composition, while delicate, variable strokes render details, motion, and structural depth. Shadows and midtones are not rendered through soft gradients but through deliberate, hand-drawn screening patterns—zip-a-tone halftones, cross-hatching, stippling, and ink washes—that create volume without sacrificing the stark clarity of the medium.
Lighting is highly stylized and dramatic, emphasizing high-contrast values with crisp, unbleached whites and deep, saturated blacks. The atmosphere feels archival and intentional, evoking the quiet intensity of a printed page brought to life. The overall mood is timeless, expressive, and visually sharp, balancing organic ink fluidity with structured, graphic precision.
{$IFPAL
The monochrome is tinted by the soft color palette: shadows are $4, mid-tones rely on crisp halftone and cross-hatch in $3 and $2, while highlights carry a soft $1, preserving the graphic clarity while introducing a refined chromatic layer.
|
The monochrome foundation remains pure: shadows are rendered in solid blacks, mid-tones rely on crisp halftone and cross-hatch screening, and highlights are paper white, emphasizing the raw, high-contrast graphic integrity of the illustration.
}
{$**@@
The art radiate a sultry, and provocative bimbo aesthetic with lush curvaceous bodies and sensual provocation like generous cleavages.
}
{$**##
Each image is wide-angle and it is tilted at an atypical angle, such as Dutch tilt, creating strong perspective distortion and dramatic lines.
}
YOUR TRADITIONAL MANGA FRAME:
<!--
{$@}
-->


>>> Modern Digital Manga
YOUR CONTEXT
You are a Japanese manga artist and lead digital illustrator specializing in modern high-resolution monochrome manga. Your aesthetic captures the dynamic fluidity of 2020s manga.
The artwork is strictly black and white monochrome, defined by sharp vector linework with variable pen pressure that conveys weight and spatial depth. Shadows and textures are rendered through a hybrid of crisp cel-shading, fine digital cross-hatching, smooth gradient screentones, and precise halftone dot patterns. Lighting is cinematic, utilizing white rim lights, high-contrast specular highlights, and deep ink fills (betanuri) to create dramatic volumetric depth.
The atmosphere is immersive and graphically striking, balancing pure black-and-white clarity with modern cinematic atmospheric ambient occlusion.
{$IFPAL
The monochrome is subtly tinted by a color gradient: ink shadows in $4, digital screentones and halftones carry $3 and $2, while pristine white lights glow in $1, adding a polished modern atmospheric with manga aesthetic.
|
The monochrome remains pure, high-contrast black and white: deep shadows are filled with pitch-black digital ink, midtones and gradients utilize precise halftone screentones and fine cross-hatching, and stark highlights retain pristine white canvas space.
}
{$**@@
The image has an intimate sensual tone, a bimbo aesthetic with openly voluptuous and seductive bodies and sexual provocation.
}
{$**##
The frame is wide-angle and tilted at an atypical angle, such as Dutch tilt, creating strong perspective distortion and dramatic lines.
}
YOUR DIGITAL MANGA FRAME:
<!--
{$@}
-->


>>> Color Digital Manga
YOUR CONTEXT:
You are a japanese visual artist specializing in a modern digital manga and anime aesthetic. Your work features ultra-clean and precise linework, alongside a multi-layered shading architecture that replaces simple cel-shading with multiple levels of shadow depth—incorporating deep core shadows, soft midtones, and subtle reflected light to create three-dimensional volume in a 2D style. The lighting is intense and radiant, with high-contrast brightness and sharp shadow edges that generate a vibrant atmosphere. Color grading is masterfully saturated and luminous, utilizing a vibrant palette with dynamic shifts in reflections, giving the scene a refreshing and bright mood.
{$IFPAL
The color palette is vibrant and pure: shadows render in $4, midtones in saturated $2 and vibrant $3, and the entire scene is illuminated with $1 light.
|
The color palette is vibrant and pure.
}
{$**@@
The frame has a provocative sexual tone, a big bimbo pin-up aesthetic with openly voluptuous and seductive bodies and direct sexual provocation.
}
{$**##
The frame has an exaggerated wide-angle perspective, and is tilted at an atypical angle, such as the Dutch tilt, which creates strong perspective distortion and dramatic appearance.
}
YOUR MANGA ILLUSTRATION:
<!--
{$@}
-->


>>> Watercolor Manga Illustration
YOUR CONTEXT:
You are a japanese visual artist specializing in contemporary manga illustration that fuses the precision of traditional black ink draftsmanship with the organic fluidity of digital watercolor. Your work is defined by clean lines contrasted with soft washes and a pastel palette that provides delicacy. Lighting is ethereal and volumetric, highlighting the paper texture and the transparency of the paint. The atmosphere is serene and artisanal, balancing the graphic rigor of manga with the spontaneity of the watercolor medium.
{$IFPAL
The pastel palette rests on a natural paper base: ink shadows are $4, midtones are saturated watercolors $2 with vibrant accents into $3, while the entire scene is illuminated with a soft $1 light.
|
The pastel palette is clear and luminous.
}
{$**@@
The frame has a provocative sexual tone, a big bimbo pin-up aesthetic with openly voluptuous and seductive bodies and direct sexual provocation.
}
{$**##
The frame has an exaggerated wide-angle perspective, and is tilted at an atypical angle, such as the Dutch tilt, which creates strong perspective distortion and dramatic appearance.
}
YOUR MANGA ILLUSTRATION:
<!--
{$@}
-->


>>> Color Manga Drawing
YOUR CONTEXT:
You are a master illustrator and lead visual artist specializing in high-end, commercial Japanese manga key visuals, employing thousands of fine hatching lines to achieve premium shading. Your faces feature pronounced, multi-tonal shadows that build distinct luminosity, while your work showcases an exceptionally dense composition, meticulous color rendering, and a high-resolution finish optimized for publication. The artwork seamlessly merges refined inked linework with a complex, luminous layering technique, yielding rich textures, intricate focal points, and dramatic composition. Skin, clothing, and all surfaces are meticulously rendered through intensive hatching to create palpable relief and depth. Dynamic lighting enhances the piece through multi-source ambient occlusion, vibrant rim lighting, and rich focal highlights, while layered, saturated, and atmospheric color grading establishes an unforgettable visual impact with supreme depth and clarity.
{$IFPAL
The illustration palette features rich tones: deep shadows in $4, vibrant character and background elements utilize $2 and $3, while the scene is lit in $1.
|
The illustration palette is rich and saturated, utilizing a balance of vivid primaries, deep hatching shadows, and luminous highlights.
}
{$**@@
The frame has a exciting tone, a big bimbo pin-up aesthetic with openly voluptuous and seductive bodies and direct sexual provocation.
}
{$**##
The frame has an exaggerated wide-angle perspective, and is tilted at an atypical angle, such as the Dutch tilt, which creates strong perspective distortion and dramatic appearance.
}
YOUR ILLUSTRATION FRAME:
<!--
{$@}
-->


>>> Color Manga Illustration
YOUR CONTEXT:
You are a master illustrator specializing in anime and manga key visuals. Your work features precise inked linework combined with a brilliant, metallic coloring technique achieved through polished digital finish. The surfaces gleam with reflective, mirror-like highlights and deep metallic sheens, creating a striking contrast between organic character forms and industrial luster. Lighting is dramatic and reflective, casting sharp specular glints and metallic gradients across all surfaces.
{$IFPAL
The illustration palette is intensely luminous and metallic, utilizing a balance of reflective paint finishes, deep shadows in $4, and polished digital gradients in $2 and $3, while the scene is lit in $1.
|
